data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google's ML Kit Smart Reply API
data.what_it_does: Provides a bridge to native ML Kit Smart Reply, generating suggested replies for messages via platform channels.
use_when: Need quick reply suggestions in a chat UI
App targets only iOS and Android
data.setup_notes: Add plugin to pubspec, set iOS deployment target ≥15.0, add linker flags (-ObjC, -all_load), download ML Kit resource bundles and copy to Xcode target, ensure Android minSdk 21 and targetSdk 36.
